in_hebrew.name: Hoffarth
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Fighter, Brave Heart
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hoffarth הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German words hof ‘courtyard’ and arth ‘strong, powerful’. This name was given to warriors in medieval Europe. It symbolizes bravery and courage.

in_greek.name: Hoffarth
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fighter, Brave Heart
in_greek.long_meaning: Hoffarth είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German words hof ‘courtyard’ and arth ‘strong, powerful’. This name was given to warriors in medieval Europe. It symbolizes bravery and courage.

in_latin.name: Hoffarth
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fighter, Brave Heart
in_latin.long_meaning: Hoffarth est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German words hof ‘courtyard’ and arth ‘strong, powerful’. This name was given to warriors in medieval Europe. It symbolizes bravery and courage.
